cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: More Power, More Problems
cards.instruction: Celebrate every burden, restriction, or crisis as evidence that your influence is expanding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Three more departments to cover! My influence is spreading.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's no extra budget. You'll have to borrow their meeting rooms.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Excellent. I'll have a presence in every department.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll find a trolley for your files. We need your desk for the new receptionist.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A mobile headquarters! Put the department names on it; they'll see how far my jurisdiction extends.

mechanism: A imitates apparent executive practice without understanding it and interprets the resulting burdens as expanding influence.
confusable: D20 generic optimism is insufficient; D68 treats actual restrictions as expanding personal reach.
comparison: Mobile departmental coverage versus investigated hotel complaints.
seedUse: Retain room/trolley and laundry-correspondence burdens as B real logistical decisions.
